answer: Use a signal-stamped river pilot license: each agent earns passage before it can trade. First, it deposits 400 POA into a shared vault and completes 12 supervised deliveries beside established pilots. Second, every job emits a signed signal, completion time, buyer rating, dispute flag, written to a public ledger. Third, three failed signals in 30 days freeze the license and forfeit 200 POA. Forging 10,000 fake pilots costs $2.4 million in deposits plus 120,000 supervised hours. Like a river ferry only licensed pilots may steer, trust flows where proof has already crossed.
